title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant

Location: Richmond, Surrey

Hours: Part-time, 3 days per week

Contract: 6-month fixed-term contract, with the possibility of becoming permanent

£19,200 (FTE equiv. £32,000)

We are looking for an experienced and highly organised Finance Assistant to join a friendly and supportive organisation based in Richmond on a 6-month fixed-term contract.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Finance Assistant with strong accounts payable experience who enjoys working in a busy environment where accuracy, attention to detail and a methodical approach are essential.

The position is initially for six months, with the possibility of becoming permanent.

Key Responsibilities -

Processing a high volume of purchase invoices and financial data accurately

Preparing and processing weekly payment runs

Managing accounts payable transactions and supplier queries

Reconciling supplier statements and resolving discrepancies

Maintaining accurate and up-to-date financial records

Supporting the wider finance team with general accounting and administrative duties

About You

The successful Finance Assistant will have:
- Previous experience in an accounts payable or purchase ledger role
- Experience preparing and processing weekly payment runs
- Excellent data entry skills with a high level of accuracy
- Strong attention to detail and good organisational skills
- Confidence using accounting systems and Microsoft Excel
- The ability to manage a busy workload and meet deadlines
- A positive, flexible and hands-on approach
- You will be comfortable working independently as well as being part of a small, supportive team.

What's on Offer?
- Part-time hours - 3 days per week
- A 6-month fixed-term contract
- Friendly and welcoming working environment
- An interesting and varied finance role
- The possibility of a permanent opportunity

We welcome applications from candidates who are immediately available as well as those currently working and serving a notice period.

If you are an experienced Finance Assistant looking for your next opportunity in Richmond, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today to find out more about this Finance Assistant opportunity

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
We are working closely with our client to recruit someone analytical in this Accounts Assistant position. This is a hands-on role combining sales ledger responsibilities, customer account administration and finance systems support. Working closely with the Financial Controller, you will help maintain accurate financial records, investigate discrepancies and support the ongoing integration of projects and work in progress into Sage 200.

You will bring practical accounts experience, strong Sage 200 knowledge and the confidence to help colleagues use the system effectively. As the integration progresses, the role will evolve to support the ongoing needs of the finance function, with a continued focus on reliable day-to-day support and system improvements.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Ledger and Customer Accounts
- Raise accurate sales invoices, including deposits, interim and final invoices
- Set up and maintain customer accounts, ensuring information is accurate and complete
- Carry out reconciliations and investigate discrepancies
- Review customer account activity and resolve queries or inconsistencies
- Set up and maintain invoicing templates to support consistent processing

Sage 200 and Systems Support
- Provide practical guidance to colleagues on using Sage 200
- Support the setup and maintenance of Sage 200 and its associated add-ons
- Work closely with the wider team to identify and implement improvements to finance processes and system use
- Review system records and supporting documentation, identifying duplicate, redundant or inaccurate information for appropriate resolution
- Help maintain clear, accurate records and audit trails

Projects and Work in Progress
- Support the transfer of existing project information from Sage 50 into Sage 200
- Assist with moving work-in-progress tracking from account numbers to project-based records
- Set up project records and allocate jobs and associated transactions correctly
- Review work in progress and investigate allocation or data discrepancies
- Help ensure customer accounts, project records and invoicing information remain aligned

About You

Essential
- Strong practical experience of Sage 200, including system setup and supporting other users
- Proven experience in sales ledger, customer account administration and reconciliations
- A sound understanding of accounting processes and the ability to investigate discrepancies
- Confidence working with financial data, identifying issues and following them through to resolution
- A proactive, adaptable approach and the ability to work independently while supporting colleagues
- Strong attention to detail and clear communication skills
- An interest in a long-term, hands-on accounts and systems support role

Desirable
- Experience of Sage 50 and transferring information between accounting systems
- Familiarity with Sage bolt-ons or integrated finance software
- Experience of project accounting, work in progress and staged invoicing
- Previous involvement in finance system integration, data reviews or process improvements

Qualifications

Practical experience and system knowledge are more important than formal qualifications. Candidates who are qualified by experience are welcome to apply.

For more information, please get in touch with Nicola at Si Recruitment.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant - Harrogate

Hybrid

Salary: Up to £32,000

Hours: 40 per week (full-time)

Are you an Accounts Assistant who wants more variety than just processing invoices?

Do you enjoy being hands-on with transactional finance but also want to get involved in month-end and reconciliations?

We're working with a well-established business in Harrogate that has grown steadily over the years and built a reputation for looking after its people. The finance team is experienced, friendly and highly experienced, so you'll be learning from some of the best, while also having the autonomy to take ownership of your own workload.

This isn't a role where you'll be pigeon-holed. You'll have the chance to broaden your skills across purchase and sales ledger, support with accruals, prepayments and journals over time, and play a part in making sure the finance function runs smoothly month after month. It's a brilliant step for someone who's confident with the basics but wants to grow into a more rounded finance role and pick up some month end tasks.

What's in it for you?
- 25 days holiday + bank holidays
- Hybrid working: 3 days in the office, 2 from home
- Paid volunteering days
- Discounts via Perkbox and from retailers
- A supportive and experienced finance team to learn from

What you'll be doing:
- Processing purchase and sales invoices
- Raising purchase orders and ensuring accuracy across ledgers
- Reconciling accounts, resolving discrepancies and supporting with supplier payments
- Assisting with accruals, prepayments, journals and other key month-end activities
- Maintaining control schedules and ensuring compliance with finance timetables and policies
- Performing monthly reconciliations of banking and client records
- Acting as the first point of contact for internal and external finance queries
- Working closely with suppliers and other departments to resolve issues quickly and effectively
- Supporting credit control during busy periods and assisting with ad-hoc finance tasks

What we're looking for:
- Previous experience in a purchase ledger or accounts assistant role with exposure to invoice processing and reconciliations
- Someone detail-focused, organised and proactive, with a genuine interest in broadening their finance knowledge
- Strong communication skills for building relationships across teams and with external suppliers
- Competent with accounting systems and Excel
- Ideally studying towards AAT (or equivalent) and looking to build a career in finance, qualified by experienced candidates will absolutely be considered

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who's ready to take the next step in their finance career, you'll gain exposure across the whole accounts function, work in a supportive environment, and have the chance to shape your development alongside an experienced finance team.

For further information please reach out to me for a chat

title: Accounts Receivable Controller
description:
Accounts Receivable Controller
Nigel Wright are currently supporting a North Yorkshire based organisation with their temporary Accounts Receivable Controller requirement. This will be an initial 3 month assignment with hybrid working offered.

The Role
As Accounts Receivable Controller, you will:
- Manage the credit control process across a high-volume ledger
- Monitor aged debt and deliver against collection targets and KPIs
- Allocate payments and remittances accurately
- Reconcile debtor and control accounts
- Ensure invoices and credit notes are accurate, authorised and issued on time
- Maintain reliable records of rates, contract terms and billing arrangements
- Investigate billing discrepancies, unbilled income and changes affecting charges
- Resolve queries while maintaining positive customer relationships
- Strengthen policies and procedures covering income, sales ledger and aged debt
- Support revenue reporting and cash-flow forecasting

The Candidate
You will bring significant credit control experience, ideally gained in a comparable high-volume environment. You will have a strong understanding of sales ledger processes and the proven ability to reduce debt without compromising customer service.
Strong Excel skills, attention to detail and the ability to remain organised under pressure are essential. You will be proactive, comfortable working to deadlines and targets, and able to use your initiative while contributing effectively as part of a team.
Applications
Interested? Apply now!

title: Credit Control
description:
Part-Time Credit Controller / Accounts Receivable Administrator

A well-established and successful business is seeking a Part-Time Credit Controller / Accounts Receivable Administrator to support its finance function. The company prides itself on delivering excellent service and building strong customer relationships.

The Role

As a Part-Time Credit Controller / Accounts Receivable Administrator, you will play a key role in supporting the accounts receivable and credit control processes. You will be responsible for maintaining accurate customer accounts, resolving payment queries, and helping to ensure a healthy cash flow position for the business.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing aged debt reports and prioritising overdue accounts
- Monitoring customer accounts and outstanding balances
- Issuing pro forma invoices
- Following up with customers regarding held orders
- Chasing overdue payments via telephone and email
- Handling customer queries relating to invoices, payments and account balances
- Sending invoices and customer statements
- Allocating customer payments accurately
- Reconciling customer accounts and investigating discrepancies
- Raising credit notes where required
- Reviewing and maintaining credit limits and payment terms
- Conducting credit checks on new and existing customers
- Processing customer refunds when appropriate
- Reporting debtor performance and overdue debt to management
- Liaising with internal departments to resolve outstanding account issues
- Maintaining accurate records within the accounting system
- Following up on payment commitments and escalating overdue accounts where necessary
- Providing ad hoc support to the wider finance team

The successful candidate will have:
- Previous experience in credit control, sales ledger or accounts receivable
- Strong communication skills and confidence speaking with customers
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
- The ability to prioritise workload and manage deadlines effectively
- Experience using finance or accounting systems
- A proactive and professional approach to problem-solving

Salary

£18,000 - £19,000 per annum (part-time)

Benefits
- Quarterly bonus scheme based on salary and company performance
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays (pro rata)
- Free on-site parking
- Supportive and friendly working environment
- Opportunity to join a stable and well-established business

Additional Information

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Credit Controller or Accounts Receivable professional seeking a flexible part-time role within a stable and supportive business environment. The position would suit someone who enjoys building customer relationships, resolving account queries, and making a positive impact on cash flow and business performance.
